# ui::FontName

Header: `winui/render/Text.hpp`.

A font family name kept inline, so whatever holds one owns its copy: a name taken from a `std::string` stays valid after the string is gone. A literal, a `std::string_view` or a `std::string` converts to it, and it is usable in `constexpr` tables (`ui::glyphs::`). Up to [`Capacity`](#capacity) bytes of UTF-8; a longer name asserts and is cut.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::IconGlyph star_icon(const std::string& family) // a family name read from the settings
{
    return ui::IconGlyph{0xE734, family}; // copies the name
}
```

## Capacity

```cpp
static std::size_t Capacity = 63
```

The longest name it holds, in bytes.
